title: Synthetic magnetic emulsion fixture
source_text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. These statements and measurements are invented. An iron oxide-chitosan composite stabilized a sunflower oil-in-water emulsion. title: Synthetic unstable emulsion fixture
source_text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. These statements and measurements are invented. A chitosan-alginate composite stabilized an emulsion containing olive oil. Preparation occurred at pH 6.8.
